proposed_informal.text:
For the parameters used in Section 4, let $H_0=3.0610046\times10^{10}$, $\alpha,\beta>0$, $k\ge10^9/H_0$, and $T\ge H_0$. Set $a_1=0.63$, $a_2=2.851$, $b_1=0.62$, $b_2=1.048$, and $m_0=\sqrt{1+\frac23\sqrt{\frac65}}$. Define
\[
 C_1=\frac6{\pi^2}+\frac{b_2}{\log(kH_0)},\qquad
 C_2=\frac{\pi m_0b_1}{\log(kH_0)}+\frac{6m_0}{\pi kH_0}+\frac{\pi m_0b_2}{kH_0\log(kH_0)},\qquad r=\frac{kC_2}{C_1}.
\]
For a nonnegative integer $n$, write $I(A,n)=\int_0^\infty x^A e^{-2\alpha x^\beta}(\log x)^n\,dx$ for the convergent integrals below. Equation (4.17) defines
\[
\begin{aligned}
J(k,T)={}&I(\beta+\tfrac13,0)+rI(\beta-\tfrac23,0)\\
&+\frac{2I(\beta+\tfrac13,1)+2rI(\beta-\tfrac23,1)}{\log T}
+\frac{I(\beta+\tfrac13,2)+rI(\beta-\tfrac23,2)}{(\log T)^2}\\
&+\frac{2a_2\bigl(I(\beta+\tfrac16,0)+rI(\beta-\tfrac56,0)\bigr)}{a_1T^{1/6}\log T}
+\frac{2a_2\bigl(I(\beta+\tfrac16,1)+rI(\beta-\tfrac56,1)\bigr)}{a_1T^{1/6}(\log T)^2}\\
&+\frac{a_2^2\bigl(I(\beta,0)+rI(\beta-1,0)\bigr)}{a_1^2T^{1/3}(\log T)^2}.
\end{aligned}
\]
All fractional exponents are real. The dependence of $I$ and $J$ on the fixed parameters is suppressed in the paper's notation.
